 PHOTO: Xiaohongshu/Xiaohongshu_2468 PUBLISHED ON November 19, 2026 5:00 PM Stay in the know with a recap of our top stories today.
 1. Fann Wong and Christopher Lee spotted receiving volunteer award at son's school 
 Fann Wong and Christopher Lee were each spotted receiving an award for being parent volunteers at Maha Bodhi School, where their son Zed is enrolled.
 A Xiaohongshu netizen posted on Thursday (Nov 19): "Documenting my daughter's primary one awards ceremony and spotting celebrities... » READ MORE 
 2. Man dies from injuries after rushing to protect child from cyclist at Changi Beach Park 
 PHOTO: Facebook/Lynett Koh A man has died after reportedly suffering serious injuries while trying to protect a young child from an approaching cyclist at Changi Beach Park.
 Wong Wee Pui, who was believed to be in his late 60s, was taken to hospital on Nov 8 following the incident and died six days later, according to a Facebook post by his nephew's wife on Tuesday (Nov 17)... » READ MORE 
 3. Heavy departure traffic at Woodlands Checkpoint on Nov 19 morning: ICA 
 PHOTO: Land Transport Authority Travellers heading across the Causeway to Johor Bahru should expect delays.
 The Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) said in an update posted on its social media channel at 10.52am on Thursday (Nov 19) that there is heavy departure traffic at Woodlands Checkpoint due to a traffic tailback from Malaysia... » READ MORE
